marks.name: Vapi: a different field per provider
marks.why: Deepgram keywords with an intensifier, Deepgram keyterm without one, AssemblyAI keytermsPrompt. The builder has to learn the vendor's API to boost a brand name.

name: vapi-03-transcriber-fallback

marks.name: Vapi: an ordered list of backup recognisers
marks.why: Each fallback may carry its own language, and nothing states what the vocabulary loses when one takes over.

pre: (()=>{const t="manual fallbacks";const els=[...document.querySelectorAll("p, li, strong, h3")];const el=els.find(e=>(e.textContent||'').trim().toLowerCase().includes(t)&&e.getBoundingClientRect().height<200&&e.getBoundingClientRect().width>40);if(el){el.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});window.scrollBy(0,-160);}return !!el})()

marks.name: Retell: one list, provider agnostic
marks.why: A single array of strings biases whichever transcriber is running. The right shape, but it lives in the API and never appears as a control.

marks.name: LiveKit: a vendor table and an escape hatch
marks.why: Recognition is a plugin choice in code. There is no vocabulary control at all, which is what a console is for.

marks.name: Vapi: voicemail detection is windowed
marks.why: It waits a bounded time for the beep, then speaks. Detection is never certain, so the window is part of the setting.

name: retell-05-handle-voicemail

marks.name: Retell: voicemail is a two-way choice
marks.why: Hang up, or leave a message from a prompt or a fixed sentence. Our engine can only do the first, which is why the second is shown as a choice you cannot pick yet.

pre: (()=>{const t="leave a message";const els=[...document.querySelectorAll("p, li, strong, h3, td")];const el=els.find(e=>(e.textContent||'').trim().toLowerCase().includes(t)&&e.getBoundingClientRect().height<200&&e.getBoundingClientRect().width>40);if(el){el.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});window.scrollBy(0,-160);}return !!el})()

marks.name: ElevenLabs: keypad input is a system tool
marks.why: Vapi, Retell and ElevenLabs all ship this. Ours has no engine field, so it is named as missing rather than left out.

marks.name: LiveKit: silence is an event, not a setting
marks.why: You write the hang-up rule yourself in code. The rule exists either way, so the only question is whether a builder can see it.

marks.name: Vapi: speed as a raw slider
marks.why: Labelled Slower against Faster, with no number. The ends of the scale are the decision, which is the grammar we took.

marks.name: Retell: pronunciation needs a phonetic alphabet
marks.why: IPA, CMU, Pinyin or Jyutping per word. Correct, and it asks a builder to know phonetics; ours takes a spelling.

marks.name: LiveKit: expressiveness depends on the model
marks.why: The knob exists per vendor and nowhere in a single place. That is the fact behind showing vendor-native handles only when the vendor has them.

name: retell-09-quickstart

marks.name: Retell: first run starts from a template
marks.why: Every rival walls the first run behind create-an-agent, and none of them offers a way in from a competitor's config.

pre: (()=>{const t="phone agent";const els=[...document.querySelectorAll("h1, h2, h3, p")];const el=els.find(e=>(e.textContent||'').trim().toLowerCase().includes(t)&&e.getBoundingClientRect().height<200&&e.getBoundingClientRect().width>40);if(el){el.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});window.scrollBy(0,-160);}return !!el})()

marks.name: LiveKit: the first run is a repository
marks.why: A starter app you clone. Fine for an SDK, and it means the first minute belongs to a terminal rather than a console.

marks.name: Vapi: the operator verbs, as an API
marks.why: say, add-message, mute-assistant, end-call, transfer, handoff, plus a listen socket. The only documented set in the field, and it has no interface on top of it.

marks.name: ElevenLabs: interruption is an event you receive
marks.why: You can watch a call from the outside. Nothing here lets a person step into one.

marks.name: Vapi: create an assistant, then a number
marks.why: The first run is a blank assistant plus a template picker. Nothing reads a config you already own somewhere else.
